chunks.arabic_text: التهذيب: عن المفيد، عن أبي القاسم جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه، عن سعد بن عبد الله، عن أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى، عن محمد بن إسماعيل بن بزيع، عن علي بن النعمان، عن أبي مريم الأنصاري قال

translations.en: Al-Tahdhib: From al-Mufid, from Abi al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi', from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abi Maryam al-Ansari who said:

chunks.arabic_text: … إن الحسن بن علي عليهما السلام كفن أسامة بن زيد في برد حبرة …

translations.en: … al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon them both) enshrouded Usama ibn Zayd in a Hibara cloak …

en.summary: This narration from al-Tahdhib highlights the honor bestowed upon Usama ibn Zayd by Imam al-Hasan (AS), who personally enshrouded him in a 'Hibara' (a fine, often woolen or mixed fabric cloak), reflecting the close familial and spiritual ties between the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophet's trusted companion. It underscores the continuity of prophetic legacy and the high status of Usama within Shia historical memory as a figure of loyalty and virtue.
en.seo_question: Who enshrouded Usama ibn Zayd and what garment was used?

key_terms.حبرة: a type of fine fabric or cloak from Hadramawt
